family: BIGTREETECH MANTA M5P V1.0 controller (5 driver sockets, core-board host)
vendor: Shenzhen Big Tree Technology Co., Ltd.
source_level: vendor manual and SIZE drawing; pins from Klipper's example configuration for this board
title: BIGTREETECH MANTA M5P V1.0 User Manual (35 pages), SIZE-top drawing, 3D STEP
document_file: vendor_cad/staging/BIGTREETECH MANTA M5P V1.0 User Manual.pdf

input_v.source: manual p.6: VIN = DC 12 V or DC 24 V

fan_a.ports: FAN0, FAN1, Pi-FAN (switched, 5 / 12 / 24 V by jumper) and one always-on FAN

driver_sockets.source: manual p.6, p.7, p.10-12; collector's properties file

thermistors.note: 3 x 100K NTC, two selectable NTC / PT1000 by jumper

probe_port.note: proximity switch port, NPN or PNP selectable, 24 / 12 / 5 V selectable by jumper

host.what: a core board plugs onto the board's BTB headers: Raspberry Pi CM4 or BIGTREETECH CB1 (not included). The board then carries the host's USB 2.0 x 2, LAN, HDMI x 2, DSI, CSI and a 40-pin GPIO header, and a 'Pi-FAN' output
host.consequence: no separate single-board computer, no UART lead and no 5 V feed to one: the Pi Zero 2 W of the SKR-based designs is replaced by a CM4 / CB1 on the controller
not_stated: the core board's current draw and the 5 V converter's rating
mass of board or core board

board_mm.source: SIZE-top drawing (collector's properties file); manual p.8

hole_pattern_mm.source: SIZE-top drawing (collector's properties file); hole diameter not transcribed

assembly_bbox_mm.source: collector's import of the vendor STEP (3,839 solids), connector overhang included; the 134.7 MB STEP was not loaded here

pins._source: Klipper generic-bigtreetech-manta-m5p.cfg (third_party/klipper/config). The manual's pinout is an image and was not transcribed
pins.note: each driver has its own UART pin (no shared bus, no uart_address). DIAG shares the MINx endstop pin and needs its jumper (manual p.12)
pins.dir_note: direction pins as in Klipper's example ('!' = inverted); confirm each on the machine

TMC2209.note: module manual figures; usable current depends on cooling. Not for the board's separate 24-56 V motor input

driver_allocation_note: five sockets: X, Y, extruder and TWO independent Z drivers; or X, Y and three Z with no socket left for an extruder. Motor3's second connector is in parallel on the same driver
licence: no licence declared in the repository
